title: How C3 AI agents will automate predictive maintenance for Shell
summary: Shell is deploying C3 AI agents to upgrade from basic anomaly detection to fully-automated predictive maintenance across its global energy operations, building on their existing use of C3 AI Reliability Suite which already monitors over 30,000 critical equipment pieces.
problem_solved: Automates equipment failure prediction to prevent costly downtime and safety incidents in energy operations.
why_valuable: Enables a major energy company to proactively prevent equipment failures rather than reactively responding to breakdowns, reducing operational costs and improving safety.
